meta.brief: Build an AI-powered Amazon affiliate marketing platform that automates product research, identifies trending and high-converting products, analyzes pricing, reviews, competition, and commission potential, and generates SEO-optimized product articles, comparisons, and buying guides. The agent should identify profitable niches, create engaging marketing content, publish and manage affiliate links, track clicks and conversions, and continuously optimize campaigns to maximize affiliate revenue. Prioritize automation, scalability, data-driven decisions, and compliance with Amazon Associates policies and disclosure requirements.
meta.group_a: Platform capability requirements R01-R21, decomposed from the brief verbatim.
meta.group_b: Delivery requirements R22-R30, decomposed from the session instructions.

status_values.implemented: Delivered in this repository and visible on the live site.
status_values.partial: Partly delivered; the gap is stated and, where it blocks, linked to a flag.
status_values.blocked: Cannot be delivered with the data or infrastructure available; reason and flag given.

requirements.evidence: tools/build.py regenerates every page from data/*.json; docs/RESEARCH.md records the resolution method.
requirements.gap: No scheduled crawler or API-driven refresh runs on GitHub Pages (static host).

requirements.evidence: Amazon's own 'N bought in past month' demand signal captured for all three products (S2, S4, S6).
requirements.gap: Best Sellers Rank was not readable from any official static render, so it is left blank.

requirements.evidence: Conversion rate is a report inside Associates Central.
requirements.gap: No Associates account is connected, so no conversion data exists. Field left blank by rule.

requirements.evidence: Current price, list price, unit price, lowest other offer and discount depth are captured and tabulated on analysis.html.
requirements.gap: Live price tracking and price alerting are prohibited by Participation Requirements 6(y) unless Amazon agrees.

requirements.evidence: Star rating and ratings volume captured for all three products (S2, S4, S6).
requirements.gap: Star histogram and review text are JavaScript-only and behind sign-in; sentiment is not captured.

requirements.evidence: Internal three-way comparison on comparison.html across price, rating, volume, demand and commission band.
requirements.gap: No wider competitor set was captured, because only the three supplied links are in scope and no other official source was used.

requirements.evidence: The full official rate table is reproduced on commission.html (S7) with the qualifying-purchase and payment rules (S8).
requirements.gap: Amazon does not publish the commission category per ASIN, so the per-product rate is left blank rather than guessed.

requirements.evidence: One article-style page per product with title, meta description, canonical Amazon link, structured spec table and sources.
requirements.gap: Articles are authored, not machine-generated on a schedule; no LLM is wired in.

requirements.evidence: comparison.html — side-by-side table of all three products with a source link per row.
category-home-kitchen.html carries an air-fryer buying guide built only from values verified on Amazon.
Niche identified as Home & Kitchen > Air Fryers, all three supplied products land there (S1, S3, S5).
requirements.gap: Profitability per unit cannot be verified without the per-ASIN commission category.

requirements.evidence: Content pages, category guide and comparison are written; product pages carry the Amazon listing deep link.
requirements.gap: No A/B testing or content variants, because no traffic or conversion data exists to test against.

requirements.evidence: Every link is held once in data/products.json and rendered from there, so a tag can be applied in one place.
requirements.gap: No Associates tag exists, so links are untagged. The supplied short links should not be used as the live Special Links.

requirements.evidence: Clicks are reported only inside Associates Central.
requirements.gap: No Associates account connected. Field left blank by rule.

requirements.evidence: Conversions are reported only inside Associates Central.
requirements.gap: No Associates account connected. Field left blank by rule.

requirements.text: Continuously optimize campaigns to maximize affiliate revenue
requirements.evidence: Optimisation loop is specified in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md with its inputs and decision rules.
requirements.gap: A loop needs clicks and conversions, which do not exist yet, plus a runtime, which a static host does not provide.

requirements.evidence: Site is fully generated from a JSON data layer by tools/build.py; no page is hand-edited.
requirements.gap: No scheduler or runtime on GitHub Pages to execute the automation.

requirements.evidence: Adding a product is a single JSON entry; the generator emits its category page, product page and every table row.
requirements.gap: Ingestion of new products is still manual.

requirements.evidence: Every value carries a source id and a verified/unverified status; unverified values render blank and are listed on flagged.html.
compliance.html maps each obligation to the exact policy text with a link (S8, S9).
requirements.gap: Two blocking conflicts remain open on the data itself: F01 (prices) and F02 (star ratings).

requirements.evidence: Site-wide disclosure banner and a dedicated compliance page citing the FTC (S10) and Participation Requirements 3(b) (S8), which names the FTC Endorsement Guides.
requirements.gap: The Amazon affiliate disclosure text must also be enabled once a tag exists (it is currently worded to match the untagged state).

requirements.text: Create an executive summary outlining important details
requirements.evidence: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and executive-summary.html.

requirements.text: Review the repo line by line, verify from official sources, link for manual review, flag irregularities
requirements.evidence: docs/RESEARCH.md, docs/VERIFICATION.md, docs/FLAGGED.md. Repository contained only README.md at the base commit.

requirements.text: GitHub Pages live site with a clean landing page and subpages organized by category
requirements.evidence: https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone3/ — index.html plus categories.html, category-home-kitchen.html and one page per product.

requirements.text: Clean, user friendly, simple, easy to use UI like a simple dashboard
requirements.evidence: Single sidebar dashboard shell, one stylesheet, no framework, no client-side router.

requirements.text: Contain all entries and findings in a simple, easy to read table format
requirements.evidence: Products, commission table, requirements matrix, flags, sources and verification log are all tables.

requirements.text: Every table row must have a source link to an official site
requirements.evidence: Every data row carries a Source cell linking to amazon.com, affiliate-program.amazon.com or ftc.gov. Verified by tools/check_links.py.

requirements.text: If a value cannot be confirmed from an official source, leave it blank and flag it as unverified
requirements.evidence: Null-valued fields render as an explicit 'Unverified' cell, never as a guess. See docs/VERIFICATION.md.

requirements.text: Publish flagged irregularities on a clearly labeled Flagged for Review page with source links
requirements.evidence: flagged.html renders data/flags.json with a source link or an explicit 'no official source' note per item.

requirements.text: Open a pull request, merge it, confirm GitHub Pages deploys, record the result in COORDINATION.md
requirements.evidence: Recorded in COORDINATION.md task T12 after the deploy check.
